ledger.x: c. 150: Langkasuka is founded on the Pattani coast. 'Established: 2nd century' and 'generally believed to have existed from the 2nd to 15th century'; the Liangshu says it was founded over 400 years before the Liang (502-557) and one proposal puts it 'between 80 and 100 AD'. The page gives the century, not a year: 150…

c. 718: Langkasuka passes to Srivijaya. 'By the 8th century it had probably come under the control of the rising Srivijaya empire'; the srivijaya dossier carries the matching gain at 718, Cliopatria's year.
1225: a Langkasuka of its own is described again.

c. 1400: Langkasuka gives way to Patani. 'Pattani may have conquered or been formed out of Langkasuka' by the 15th century; infobox 'Disestablished: 15th century'. The year is the patani-kingdom dossier's founding; the Pasai Annals say Langkasuka was destroyed around 1370, and…

wars.name: Srivijaya's absorption of Langkasuka
wars.outcome: 'By the 8th century it had probably come under the control of the rising Srivijaya empire'; a tributary of Srivijaya in the 12th century.

wars.name: Chola raid on Srivijaya's Malay Peninsula vassals
wars.outcome: 'In 1025 it was attacked by the armies of King Rajendra Chola I'; no territorial result is named for Langkasuka.

certainty.note: The kingdom's site is unsettled (Pattani, Yala, Saiburi, Songkhla are all proposed); no frontier is given.
